description.value: The Chemainus Visitor Centre is the official tourism information office for the Chemainus and District area, operated by the Chemainus + District Chamber of Commerce. Chemainus is widely known as 'The Little Town That Did,' famous for its large-scale outdoor murals depicting local history. A touring cyclist stopping here can expect local maps, route suggestions, and area information from knowledgeable staff.
